title: Witch's Alchemical Study
description: A female witch in a green and gold robe stands at a marble desk inside a cluttered arcane workshop. She holds a glowing blue orb in one hand and a small red bottle in the other, surrounded by wooden shelves filled with potion bottles, dried poppies, scrolls, crystals, a red spellbook, melted red and purple wax seals, and hanging colorful lanterns.
prompt: A beautiful young witch with long brown hair wearing an ornate green and gold robe stands in her mystical workshop, examining a glowing blue orb and a small red potion bottle. She is surrounded by wooden shelves packed with glass jars of ingredients, dried red poppies, purple flowers, scrolls, crystals, and magical artifacts. A large red leather spellbook and melted wax seals lie on a marble table in front of her, with colorful glowing lanterns hanging above and rich purple curtains framing the scene.
